definition: A numerical label identifying devices on a network.
A unique hardware identifier assigned to a network interface card.
A set of rules enabling communication between devices on a network.
A reliable connection-oriented protocol ensuring delivered and ordered data.
A fast, connectionless protocol that does not guarantee delivery or order.
A system that translates domain names into IP addresses.
A protocol that automatically assigns IP addresses to devices.
A device that forwards data packets between networks.
A device that connects devices on the same network and forwards traffic based on MAC address.
A network security system that filters incoming and outgoing traffic.
A subdivided portion of a network used to organize and secure devices.
A local area network connecting devices within a limited area.
A wide area network that spans large geographical areas.
A virtual private network that creates a secure connection over a public network.
A formatted unit of data transmitted over a network.
